text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so an all-male panel does not indicate discrimination against you based on sex. Raising gender bias in this context lacks a logical or legal basis and would likely damage your professional credibility.

While an all-male panel may suggest poor institutional diversity practices within the public broadcaster, it does not demonstrate bias between two male applicants. The decision was explicitly tied to specific qualifications, namely digital media experience.

Do not raise the panel's gender composition. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your requested written feedback, focusing on skill development and understanding where the successful candidate's digital expertise gave him the edge.
